description.zh: 自由女神像是法国赠予美国的礼物，建于1886年，是自由与民主的全球象征。她高46米，矗立于纽约港的自由岛上，手持火炬迎接来自世界各地的移民。
description.en: A gift from France in 1886, the 46 m Statue of Liberty is a global symbol of freedom and democracy. She stands on Liberty Island in New York Harbour, welcoming immigrants from around the world.

zh: 1886年法国赠送美国的自由女神像，高93米
可登上皇冠内部俯瞰纽约港（需提前数月预订）
埃利斯岛移民博物馆同票可进
en: France's 1886 gift to America; 93 m total height
Crown access gives panoramic views of NY Harbour (book months ahead)
Combined entry includes Ellis Island Immigration Museum

admission.zh: 渡轮+观景台约25美元，皇冠门票须提前数月预订
admission.en: Ferry + grounds ~US$25; crown tickets sell out months in advance

tips.zh: 皇冠门票需提前至少3个月预订；仅参观底座和露台也非常值得，无需皇冠票。
tips.en: Crown tickets must be reserved at least 3 months ahead. The pedestal and grounds alone are well worth the trip without crown access.

description.zh: 时代广场是纽约市最具活力的地标，每年有约5,000万游客到访。林立的LED广告牌、百老汇剧院、以及新年倒计时降球活动使其成为世界最著名的十字路口。
description.en: Times Square attracts 50 million visitors annually. Towering LED billboards, Broadway theatres and the iconic New Year's Eve ball drop make it the world's most famous crossroads.

zh: 曼哈顿中心，全球最繁忙的广场之一，每年逾5,000万人次
百老汇剧院区入口，霓虹灯彻夜不息
新年倒计时「水晶球降落」地点
en: Midtown Manhattan's heart; over 50 million visitors/year
Gateway to Broadway theatre district; neon signs 24/7
Site of the New Year's Eve ball drop

tips.zh: 夜晚霓虹灯全亮时最为震撼；百老汇演出建议提前在官网购买折扣票（TKTS售亭可获当日折扣票）。
tips.en: Most impressive after dark when all the neon is blazing. For Broadway shows, buy discounted tickets at the TKTS booth or online in advance.
